1	# Clientloop — Phase 1 UI Shell Plan
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	Clientloop is the codename (from Phase 18 dossier candidates) for the ManyRequests-style SaaS already researched across 22 phases in the Boldteq dossier (`ManyRequestsDossier.jsx`). The dossier returned a **conditional GO** with a hard gate at Phase 15: 300 waitlist + 10 paid LOIs before writing code.
6	
7	Yash is **intentionally overriding** the gate for a narrow purpose: build the **UI shell only** (mock data, no backend, no auth wiring) so it can be **used as the clickable validation asset** Phase 15 already requires (Figma-alternative prototype for LOI interviews). This is the cheapest path to satisfy the gate without wasting build effort later — the shell becomes real production code once the gate passes.
8	
9	**What we are building in Phase 1:**
10	- Agency-side UI shell for Clientloop
11	- Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript (strict, no `any`) + Tailwind + shadcn/ui
12	- Three working screens: Dashboard Home, Request Inbox (table + Kanban toggle), Clients/Services/Settings
13	- All data mocked in `lib/mock/` — zero backend, zero auth, zero DB
14	- Fully responsive, dark-mode capable, production-quality look
15	- Deployable to Vercel as a static demo on day 1
16	
17	**What we are NOT building:**
18	- No Clerk, Neon, Prisma, Razorpay, Stripe, Claude API, tRPC
19	- No Request Detail + AI Brief screen (deferred — dossier's hero feature, but not in this pass per user selection)
20	- No client-facing portal (agency side only)
21	- No landing page / marketing site (separate Quill work later)
22	
23	**Why it matters:** the dossier's wedge is AI request-to-brief + flat pricing + Razorpay. The UI shell must *look* like a product that ships those things, even though none are wired. Visuals sell the LOIs.
24	
25	---
26	
27	## Name & Branding
28	
29	- **Product name (Phase 1):** Clientloop
30	- **Rationale:** shortest, most pronounceable of the 10 candidates, and the word "loop" ties directly to Phase 21's client-invite viral loop (the actual growth engine)
31	- **Trademark risk:** NOT cleared — dossier flags CHECK gate. Treat name as provisional. Use it in UI, but do not register domains or trademarks yet
32	- **Wordmark:** plain text `Clientloop` in Inter bold for v1, no logo commissioned yet
33	- **Primary color:** Violet (`#6d28d9`) — already used in the dossier artifact header, carries forward as brand accent
34	
35	---
36	
37	## Architecture Decision: Scaffold Fresh
38	
39	Confirmed via Explore agent: no existing Next.js projects in Yash's active portfolio. Rankora and CROBOT are both Vite+React+React Router (Lovable-origin) — not migratable to Next.js 15 App Router. shadcn components and Tailwind tokens are portable; everything else is a rewrite.
40	
41	**Decision:** `pnpm create next-app@latest Clientloop` at `~/Clientloop`. Copy token structure from Rankora's Tailwind config but nothing else.
42	
43	**Memory impact:** create `~/.claude/memory/stacks/saas-nextjs-15.md` after scaffold so the next Next.js SaaS inherits these patterns. (Mira runs this after Phase 1 completes.)
44	
45	---
